title: Japan Business Calendar
description: Give a list of tasks; each task is answered with one result row (and one charge). Invalid tasks return an error row and are free.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Array of task objects. type = info | isBusinessDay | addBusinessDays | businessDaysBetween | holidays | toWareki | fromWareki. Dates accept 2026-10-14, 2026/10/14, 20261014, 令和8年10月14日, R8.10.14.

closeYearEnd.title: Treat Dec 29 – Jan 3 as closed
closeYearEnd.description: Many Japanese companies and banks are closed 12/29–1/3 (the national holiday list does not include these days).

weekendDays.title: Weekend days (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday)
weekendDays.description: Days of the week that are not business days. [0,6] = Sat+Sun; [0] = open on Saturdays.

extraHolidays.title: Extra closed dates
extraHolidays.description: Company-specific closures (e.g. Obon). Same date formats as above.
